### ⭐ 取卡前置 — North Star clause 3, re-taken for THIS claim

| product repo <sub>open-issue enumeration, PRs excluded · 取数时刻 2026-09-19T10:35:01Z</sub> | open P0 | open P1 |

⇒ gate **CLOSED**. ⛔ No p2/p3 tooling or contract-hygiene card may be dispatched. This one passes as
a **product** card: a saved view exists to supply a cap, and a refused value lowers from it
unchecked into the node. Clause 2 「能跑但出错 ⇒ P2」; clause 4 「永不静默落库」.

### ⛔ One claim in this card's own body is carried into the dispatch as FALSE

The body quotes objectui#9899: 「component `0` + view `7` yields **0, not 7**」. Measured end to end on
that card and re-verified by this seat at source, it is true at the gate's output key and ⛔ false at
the wire — `$top` was **100**, the consuming renderer's own default, because objectui#9897's guard
already refuses the `0` (`packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:973` / `:1023`). ⇒ the harm in this
family is **a named view's cap DROPPED and the read going WIDER**, ⛔ not a starved query. The
dispatch carries the correction so a third card does not inherit the wrong direction; the full
reading is at objectui#9899 comment `5740998511`. ⛔ This seat did not edit this card's body — the
correction belongs on the record, not in a silent rewrite.

### ⭐ And the question this card said must be settled first now has a precedent

The body says 「drop, clamp and refuse are three different answers here」 and that the read-point
answer was chosen for a **renderer**. PR objectui#10009 settled it for the **relay** layer yesterday,
on a measurement: the gate emits one diagnostic because the repair would otherwise remove the only
place the author was told. ⇒ the dispatch requires the dev to read that shape and state whether the
argument **transfers** to a lowering layer — ⛔ it is a precedent, ⛔ not a ruling, and 「the neighbour
did it」 is refused as a reason.

### First deliverable: the population, ⛔ not the repair

The card itself records 「nobody has counted saved views carrying a non-positive
`pagination.pageSize`」. The dispatch makes that measurement the first deliverable, with a lit control
required in the same command, and carries the stop condition: non-zero **and** containing published
metadata ⇒ ⛔ push nothing and hand it back for re-grading.

### Declared file surface

`packages/core/src/data-scope/element-data-source.ts`, its co-located tests, one `.changeset/` entry.
⛔ Nothing outside `packages/core` without reporting first. ⛔ OUT: the gate (objectui#9899), every
read point (objectui#9853 / #9897 / #9925, all landed), and the declaration root (objectstack#19046).

### 在飞相交检查

This seat's other live card is objectui#9899 → PR objectui#10009 (`packages/react`), in the merge
queue. ⛔ No file overlap — but its landed behaviour is this card's immediate consumer, so the
dispatch requires a rebase onto `main` and a re-read once it lands. H17 trigger files on this board
are `pnpm-lock.yaml` (objectui#8348, objectui#9868); the dispatch fences the lockfile out.

Seat review of the hand-back — the dev found this seat's own correction was incomplete, and it is right — 2026-09-19T11:26Z

`Seat: domain:ui#2` · `Session: session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq` · PR objectui#10014, head `5e65b4e85`

## ⭐⭐ Q2 first, because it changes what this family believes

This seat put a correction into this card's dispatch: 「the harm is a named view's cap DROPPED and the
read going **WIDER**, ⛔ not a starved query」, carried from objectui#9899's end-to-end measurement.

⛔ **That correction is PATH-SPECIFIC, and this seat stated it as family-wide.** The dev measured a
**second consumer of `composed.limit` that nobody in this family had looked at** —
`ViewDataProvider.resolveElementDataSource` — and it forwards to `DataFetcher.fetchRecords` with **no
guard of its own**. Re-verified by this seat at source on `origin/main`
(`packages/core/src/data-scope/ViewDataProvider.ts`): it calls `composeElementDataSource(config, view)`
and hands the result straight to `this.resolve(...)`; there is no positivity check anywhere between.
The dev measured `0`, `-10` and `25.5` all reaching the fetcher verbatim.

⇒ ⭐ **both directions are real, on different consumers.** On the renderer path the cap is dropped and
the read goes wider (objectui#9899's reading). On the `ViewDataProvider` path there is no renderer,
nothing guards, and the ORIGINAL 「starved read」 direction — the one this seat told the dev not to
inherit — **holds literally**. The dev did not inherit it and did not take this seat's word for it;
it measured both. That is the right response to a correction handed down from a seat.

⚠️ ⇒ the family's 「every read point is repaired」 framing is **incomplete rather than wrong**: the
earlier cards reasoned about renderers that all guard themselves, and this path does not. Re-grading
that blast radius is ⛔ not this seat's act and ⛔ not the dev's. It is carried into the card filed
below, addressed to triage.

## ⭐ Q1 — ratified A, and the reason is better than 「zero」

The dispatch demanded a **lit control** on the population. The dev found the control **DARK** and said
so instead of dressing the zero up: the tree holds exactly **two** authored saved views, and neither
carries a row cap in any spelling — ⇒ 「no saved view carries a refused cap」 says nothing about refused
caps. ⭐ That is the instrument discipline this lane keeps paying for, applied against the dev's own
headline number.

It then substituted a **wider, lit** instrument — the same carriers in any metadata position:
`pagination.pageSize` 9 total / 9 legitimate / **0 refused**; flat `pageSize` 16/16/**0**; flat `limit`
11/11/**0**, control lit in every row, independently landing on the values PR objectui#10009 reported.
⇒ zero refused **authored** metadata, zero **published** metadata ⇒ the re-grade switch does not fire
and the rule may land.

⭐ The dev's own note on why the dark control does not block: the harm needs no shipped fixture,
because saved views arrive at runtime from an adapter's `listViews` overlay that **no tree-scoped
census can see**. Accepted. ⇒ **A ratified**, with the card's headline instrument recorded as dark
rather than green.

## Q3 — ratified A. The conclusion transfers, the mechanism does not, and the dev said which.

The dispatch refused 「the neighbour did it」 as a reason and demanded the transfer question be
answered. It was, on evidence: objectui#10009 emits from a **React effect** because the gate is a
component; `composeElementDataSource` is **pure** and the render path calls it from a `useMemo`, so a
warning inside it would fire during render and on every re-render — ⭐ the very thing objectui#10009
avoided. The dev therefore followed **this module's own** established refusal shape
(`elementDataSourceViewNotFoundMessage`: a pure builder, reported by each caller) rather than the
neighbour's. Confirmed by this seat at source: that builder sits in the same function.

## ⚠️ The cost this PR carries, stated rather than buried

After this branch, the **renderer path has no reporter at all** for a refused VIEW cap: gate messages
0 before and 0 after, while the node's key goes from `0` to **absent**, and the renderer treats an
absent key as 「not a mistake」. ⇒ on that path this PR is **wire-neutral and strictly reduces what the
author is told** — the exact cost objectui#10009 paid to avoid.

⇒ **The seat's call: this lands anyway, and the gap is chartered in the same act.** The reason is a
comparison, not a preference: on the `ViewDataProvider` path a refused cap reaches a real fetcher
today, and a live wrong query outranks a temporarily missing diagnostic. ⛔ It is not being landed
quietly — it is in the PR body's own open-items section because the dev put it there, it is here, and
it is a card.

## Filed from this hand-back

- **objectui#10015** — the gate adopts the new exported builder, closing the diagnostic gap above;
  carries the family re-grade ask to triage.
- **objectui#10016** — the BINDING's own `limit`, the other operand of
  `config.limit ?? savedViewLimit(view)`, is still admitted unchecked, so `dataSource: { object, limit: 0 }`
  reaches `fetchRecords` as `0` on the same path this PR repairs for the view's half. ⭐ Deliberately
  not fixed in place: the precedence question (does a refused binding cap suppress the view's
  legitimate one?) is live, and nothing in the new pin asserts an answer — so whoever settles it will
  not have to edit a pin that endorsed one.

## ⛔ And a correction this seat owes on its own dispatch

The brief cited the spec's positive `limit` declaration at `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:234`.
⛔ Wrong twice over, measured: there is **no `packages/spec` in this repo** (the spec arrives as the
dependency `@objectstack/spec`), and line 234 of that file in the published tag is a docblock about
**retired component types**. The declaration is real — verified BY CONTENT as
`limit: z.number().int().positive()`, in `component.zod.ts` — only the pointer was false.

⭐ This seat copied that address out of the card body **in the same brief that warned the dev this
family had already shipped one `file:line` written from memory**. It is the second, and it is this
seat's. Added as the third measured instance to objectstack#19199.

## Next

Waiting on the full shard matrix against `5e65b4e85`. ⛔ Nothing lands until every gate job reads
`completed: success` and `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr` is re-run on the FINAL file list.
